end.summary:
Harsh practised reading ordered pairs and identifying horizontal and vertical movement.
Harsh practised using coordinate signs to identify quadrants and reflect points.
They still need more practice placing points on axes and reflecting them in an axis.
Harsh continued to place a point with y = 0 in a quadrant; this was not corrected by the last seen turn.
end.parentNote: Harsh practised reading ordered pairs, moving right or left and up or down, and using signs to identify quadrants. They used the order of the numbers to distinguish points such as (3, 2) and (2, 3), and identified several quadrant examples using the signs. The mix-up that every point belongs to a quadrant, including points on an axis, was still present at the last seen turn. At home, ask Harsh to sort a few points into quadrant, x-axis, or y-axis, then reflect one point across each axis.

तो वो −3, −1 पर रहेगा ना... मतलब, नीचे नहीं जाएगा तो वहीं पे तो है। गेम खेलें, सर?

Neeche kadam na lein, to rin teen, shunya par hi rahenge; rin teen, rin ek par nahi. Is vishay ka taiyaar khel nahi mila, par abhi bolkar ek chhota khel khelte hain. Main bindu bolungi, aap batayein woh dhuri par hai ya chaturthansh mein: rin teen, shunya kahan hai?
